title: THE STASH SHOWS MORE AT ONCE
why: His order of 2026-10-08 (fix this then), his pick Medium: on the default stash layout the tiles were 230 pixels times the menu zoom, so a TV showed about 3 across and 5 on screen with 435 things in his stash. The tiles are about half that now: about 6 across and three rows on screen at 1080p and 4K alike, and the backpack about 4 across. The pictures still fill most of each tile.
now: The stash shows about 6 tiles across instead of 3, so much more fits on screen.
